trial_court: Court of Shri Raj Kumar, District Judge, Commercial Court-01, Dwarka Courts (S/W), Delhi
case_name: M/S Redbird Flight Training Academy vs M/S National Insurance Co. Ltd

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: M/S Redbird Flight Training Academy Pvt. Ltd. (plaintiff)

facts_of_case: The plaintiff M/S Redbird Flight Training Academy is a company that has an outstanding amount of Rs.1,13,36,667/- with the defendant M/s National Insurance Co. Ltd., which is an insurance company.

legal_principles.principle: The Insured shall at all times use due diligence and do and concur in doing everything reasonably practicable to avoid accidents and to avoid or diminish any loss hereon.
legal_principles.held: The Insured shall comply with all air navigation and airworthiness orders and requirements issued by any competent authority affecting the safe operation of the Aircraft.

legal_principles.principle: The Insured shall comply with all air navigation and airworthiness orders and requirements issued by any competent authority affecting the safe operation of the Aircraft.
legal_principles.held: The Insured shall ensure that: (a) Aircraft is airworthy at the commencement of each Flight, (b) Log Books and other records in connection with the Aircraft which are required by any official regulations in force from time to time shall be kept up to date and shall be produced to the Insurers or their Agents on request.

outcome.final_order: The plaintiff's suit for recovery of the outstanding amount was allowed and the court ordered the defendant to pay the principal amount plus interest.
